evidence.title: Feather – Simply beautiful open source icons
GitHub - feathericons/feather: Simply beautiful open-source icons

name: Feather
summary: Open-source SVG icon set drawn on a 24x24 grid, with npm package, sprite and Figma library.
description: A collection of open-source SVG icons where each icon is designed on a 24x24 grid with an emphasis on simplicity, consistency and flexibility. Use it as the feather-icons npm package, a client-side script from a CDN, an SVG sprite or the Figma component library; the site lets you customise size, stroke width and color per icon.
contains: each icon designed on a 24x24 grid
usage: client-side JavaScript, Node/npm, SVG sprite, Figma component library
size, stroke width and color customisable in the browser
framework ports: react-feather, vue-feather-icons, svelte-feather-icons, angular-feather, php-feather …
